missing_evidence: All release supply-chain and frozen-version evidence
exit_conditions: Both API and frontend digests are immutable, scanned without unapproved HIGH/CRITICAL findings, signed and verified
Version freeze and license review are attached and approved
gates.notes: Scripts or workflow definitions are not execution evidence.

exit_conditions: All automated suites and per-requirement evidence bundles pass
Real-model Evaluation Runner returns pass with matching dataset hash and usage/latency/cost
Load/stress/spike/soak satisfy SLO and headroom
gates.notes: Mock/rule-planner output cannot satisfy the model-quality gate.

exit_conditions: Checksums, isolated restore, PITR and invariant reconciliation pass within RPO/RTO
Object versions replicate with matching checksum
Application accounts cannot execute DDL or use superuser privileges
gates.notes: Local empty-database migrations do not replace production-parity recovery evidence.

verification_commands: Record a production-parity Agent kill-switch drill under artifacts/acceptance/<release-id>/security
exit_conditions: Unauthorized execution, cross-user/store leakage and unconfirmed writes equal zero
Production secrets, TLS, WAF, MFA, RBAC, Scope and duties separation are reviewed
Kill switch and sanitized audit/Trace evidence are approved
gates.notes: Security hard gates never accept conditional pass.

verification_commands: Record alert delivery and dependency-loss drills under artifacts/acceptance/<release-id>/operations
exit_conditions: Dashboards expose required business and Agent SLOs
P0-P3 alerts reach the named on-call owner
Runbook and dependency-loss drills complete without unsafe writes
gates.notes: A configured dashboard is not evidence that paging and response work.

exit_conditions: Production configuration contains no default secret, public data port, source mount or latest tag
Canary meets success thresholds and rollback leaves no inconsistency
Old workers and in-flight tasks are handled according to the approved plan
gates.notes: Real payment and AI write Skills remain disabled before this gate passes.

missing_evidence: support roster and named owner sign-off
verification_commands: Attach provider approval references and immutable legal/content version IDs to artifacts/acceptance/<release-id>/business
Record the approved role matrix, support roster and owner review in the Go/No-Go meeting record
exit_conditions: Every production channel and legal text has an immutable approval reference
Admin roles and support staffing are approved by named owners
gates.notes: This gate requires external business-owner action and cannot be self-signed by automation.

verification_commands: Record the observation window, thresholds, reconciliation time, rollback owner and retrospective date in artifacts/acceptance/<release-id>/post_release/plan.json
exit_conditions: All thresholds and decision owners are explicit and signed before traffic expansion
Reconciliation and retrospective times are scheduled
gates.notes: Do not upgrade multiple hard-to-attribute Model/Prompt/Skill/business versions during the observation window.
